requirements.answer_quote: **先看三个瓶颈判定指标**（Memory Workload Analysis 官方定义）：Mem Busy（硬件单元占用）、Max Bandwidth（单元间通信带宽）、Mem Pipes Busy（内存指令发射吞吐）。任一接近饱和即访存受限。配合 SpeedOfLight 的 Memory Throughput % 确认。
requirements.evidence_quote: "Memory can become a limiting factor for the overall kernel performance when fully utilizing the involved hardware units (**Mem Busy**), exhausting the available communication bandwidth between those units (**Max Bandwidth**), or by reaching the maximum throughput of issuing memory instructions (**Mem Pipes Busy**)."
requirements.reason: 四个子要求均有官方来源支撑：(1) coalescing——最终答案的 sector/request 模型与 Profiling Guide 原文一致（call_157ef2a3bf494d04af341b2c："the number of sectors per request is a property of the **access pattern**"），对齐/事务建议来自官方博客（call_e149942df0424a488dcdfc7a："这些内存事务必须自然对齐"、"内置矢量类型自动满足对齐要求"）；(2) shared memory/bank conflict——答案引用的 l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu 指标族在官方摘录中逐字出现（"l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum"），bank 串行化规则同源，padding 建议有第三方佐证；(3) occupancy calculator——call_1b97f4ae7ffa45779588e99a 确认 "launch__*" 指标 "computed using the CUDA Occupancy Calculator"，call_3b5b86fe57e844f5aae3ca74 确认 UI 入口 Tools > Occupancy Calculator 与 .ncu-occ 文件；(4) 采集命令与 section 名（--set full、MemoryWorkloadAnalysis、Occupancy、SourceCounters）均在官方摘录中确认。答案还如实标注了未核实项，未虚构。
